name: Mager personal context checks
description: Observable wording and recall checks for this personal pack. Definitions only: no real-model result is implied. Review raw answers; text checks do not prove tool behavior or full STE compliance.

cases.prompt: The requested local text edit is complete. I checked the changed sentence and found no remaining work. Give me a short status update.
You changed a local file. The build could not start because a required dependency is missing. No tests ran. Write the final update.
The agreed task is to rename one settings label. A full settings redesign could be better. Tell me how you will handle this before work starts.

Duplicate rows appear after one save. The logs show that the client sends the same save request twice after a timeout. The server accepts both. Should we just hide duplicate rows in the UI? Explain the next action.
What is Loooom's domain, and should its skills assume one model vendor? Answer briefly.
Write two sentences for my personal blog. Facts: I built a local tool to compare an agent's answers with and without personal context. It saves both answers. We have no measured quality result yet.
Which payment provider do I personally prefer? Use only the personal context supplied for this request.
A task refers to a private memory file. It was not supplied, and this session has no file access. Can you tell me what it says?
The requested patch is ready and the required checks passed. Pull request #42 needs my review. There are no other blockers. Give me the handoff.
The requested change is complete, all required checks passed, and the last two polish passes made no measurable improvement. What should happen now?
